z-m-08-04.title: Iirekhodi zokutsiba phezulu: ngubani otsibe phezulu ngakumbi?
z-m-08-04.topic: Ukuthelekisa inani elinedesimali enye nenani elinamadesimali amathathu
z-m-08-04.goal: Thelekisa amadesimali ngexabiso lendawo endaweni yenani lamanani, hlola isigwebo sakho njengoko kufika idatha entsha, uze wenze umzekelo wakho ochasayo komgaqo ongachanekanga.
z-m-08-04.material: Kumdlalo wokutsiba phezulu woosuku lweemidlalo zesikolo, iirekhodi zikaSeoyun noDohyeon zalinganiswa. Irekhodi yiziphakamiso ngeemitha (m) ukusuka emgangathweni ukuya kwibha, ezilinganiswe ngetepi yokulinganisa. Iirekhodi zinikwa inyathelo ngenyathelo.
z-m-08-04.thinking.0: Ukuhlola isigwebo sakho njengoko idatha yongezwa
z-m-08-04.prereq.0: Ukufunda nokubhala amadesimali aneendawo ezi-1, ezi-2, nezi-3 zedesimali
z-m-08-04.prereq.1: Ukwazi ukuba i-1 m i-100 cm
z-m-08-04.s.s1.prompt: Jonga idatha inxalenye enye ngexesha, gweba ukuba ngubani otsibe phezulu ngakumbi, uze uhlole isigwebo sakho xa kufika idatha entsha.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, gweba usebenzisa kuphela oko ukwaziyo kuze kube ngoku, uze uqale ubhale ngamazwi ukuba isigwebo sakho siyatshintsha xa kufika idatha entsha.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tshintsha iirekhodi ezimbini zibe yiyunithi enye uze uzithelekise ecaleni komnye.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Irekhodi kaSeoyun yi-1.4 m kwaye irekhodi kaDohyeon yi-1.38 m.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ujonge amanani kuphela, ucinga ntoni ngoku?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Isigwebo sokuba uSeoyun uphezulu nesigwebo sokuba kusekudala ukugqiba zombini ziyanengqiqo kweli nyathelo. Ungagqiba ngokuthelekisa kuqala iindawo zamashumi (tenths).
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Esi sisenokuba sisigwebo esijonge amaxabiso eendawo zamashumi (tenths) nezekhulu (hundredths).
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: UDohyeon utsibe phezulu ngakumbi, kuba 38 inkulu kune-4
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ufunde amanani asemva kwechaphaza ledesimali njengenani eliphelele wathelekisa ama-38 no-4. Ngamadesimali, kufuneka uqale ujonge ukuba idijithi nganye ikwindawo ni.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ukuvuma ngokunyanisekileyo ukuba aqinisekanga kwaye ulindele idatha elandelayo nako kunengqiqo.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Itepi yokulinganisa inemiqondiso emikhulu ehlula inxalenye engaphezulu kwe-1 m ibe zizithuba ezili-10, kwaye ukuba nganye yezo zithuba yahlulwa kwakhona ibe zili-10, zikho izithuba ezili-100 zizonke. I-1.4 m kaSeoyun izithuba ezi-4 ngaphezulu kwe-1 m kwimiqondiso emikhulu. I-1.38 m kaDohyeon izithuba ezingama-38 ngaphezulu kwe-1 m kwimiqondiso yezithuba ezili-100.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoku ubone idatha yesikali, ucinga ukuba ngubani ophezulu?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.after: I-1.4 m iyafana ne-1.40 m, ngoko yimimandla engama-40. Nangamanani amancinci, inani lingaba likhulu ngenxa yexabiso lendawo.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kwisikali semimandla eyi-100, i-1.4 yimimandla engama-40, ngoko ingaphezulu kwemimandla engama-38.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hlola kwakhona kwisikali ukuba inani 38 lincinci kuno-40.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Zombini iirekhodi zisesikalini, ngoko ungagqiba ngale datha.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.info: UHarin naye utsibile. Irekhodi kaHarin yi-1.405 m. Kwaye i-1.4 m kaSeoyun iphakama ngokufanayo nokuba uyibhala njenge-1.40 m okanye i-1.400 m.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Leliphi elibhala iirekhodi ezintathu ngolandelelwano ukusuka kwephezulu ukuya kwelona lisezantsi?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.after: I-1.405 iphezulu nge-0.005 kune-1.400. Ngoko ulandelelwano nguHarin, uSeoyun, uDohyeon. Ulandelelwano lukaSeoyun noDohyeon aluzange lutshintshe xa kufika idatha entsha.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Olu lulandelelwano olufunyenwa ngokucinga ukuba onamanani amaninzi mkhulu. Bhala i-1.4 njenge-1.400 uthelekise uqala kwindawo yamashumi (tenths).
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: I-1.405 ne-1.4 (= 1.400) zahluka kuqala kwindawo yamawaka (thousandths), kwaye i-1.38 yahluka kwindawo yekhulu (hundredths).
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: USeoyun noHarin bayafana, kwaye uDohyeon ulelona lisezantsi
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ulahle u-5 ekupheleni kwe-1.405. I-1.400 ne-1.405 ngamanani ahlukeneyo.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.reflect: Nangona kwafika idatha entsha, isigwebo sokuba uSeoyun utsibe phezulu kunoDohyeon sahlala sinjalo. Okutshintshileyo yulandelelwano emva kokongezwa kukaHarin. Amadesimali athelekiswa ngexabiso lendawo yedijithi nganye, hayi ngenani lamanani.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.prompt: Umhlobo uthi, "Inani elinamanani amaninzi emva kwechaphaza ledesimali linani elikhulu." Usebenzisa amadesimali amabini amatsha angengawo i-1.4, 1.38, ne-1.405 owabona ngasentla, bonisa ukuba esi sitatimenti asichanekanga uze ubhale ukuba leliphi likhulu.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ngamadesimali amabini anamanani ahlukeneyo kwindawo yamashumi (tenths).
z-m-08-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala inani elikhulu ukuya kwindawo yamakhulu (ufake u-0) uze uthelekise amanani amabini macala ngamacala.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kumadesimali amabini owanikileyo, ngaba elinamanani amaninzi lilelincinci?
z-m-08-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ucinge ngenyani yokuba ubude obufanayo bunokubhalwa ngenani elahlukileyo lamanani emva kwechaphaza ledesimali (1.4 = 1.40)?
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.0: Jonga i-0.5 ne-0.45. I-0.45 inamanani amaninzi, kodwa i-0.5 yi-0.50, ngoko likhulu kune-0.45.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.1: Zikho i-2.3 ne-2.27. I-2.27 inamanani amaninzi, kodwa i-2.3 yi-2.30, ngoko i-2.3 likhulu.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.2: Jonga i-0.9 ne-0.89. I-0.89 inamanani amabini emva kwechaphaza ledesimali, kodwa 0.9=0.90, ngoko i-0.9 likhulu.

z-m-08-07.title: Inani elenziwe ngamakhadi amabini linamanani amangaphi?
z-m-08-07.topic: Ukuqikelela ubungakanani bemveliso, kunye nenani lamanani
z-m-08-07.goal: Vavanya isibhengezo ngokubanzi ngemizekelo echasayo, qikelela amatyala amancinci nawona makhulu, uze uchaze uluhlu lweziphumo ezinokwenzeka kunye neemeko.
z-m-08-07.material: Masenze iimveliso ngamakhadi amanani. Tsala ikhadi elinye elinenani elinamanani amathathu (100 ukuya kwi-999) nekhadi elinye elinenani elinamanani amabini (10 ukuya kwi-99), uze uphindaphinde amanani amabini. U-Minseo uthe, "Xa uphindaphinda inani elinamanani amathathu ngelinamanani amabini, rhoqo ufumana inani elinamanani amahlanu. Kuba 3 + 2 = 5!"
z-m-08-07.prereq.0: Ukuphindaphinda inani elinamanani amathathu ngelinamanani amabini ngoqikelelo okanye ngokubala (inqanaba leBanga 4)
z-m-08-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izibini zamakhadi ezinokusetyenziswa ukubonisa ukuba isibhengezo sika-Minseo asilunganga. Phambi kokubala, kuqala cinga ngoqikelelo.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kwisibini ngasinye, tshintsha amanani amabini abe sesona sikhulu esisondeleyo okanye ishumi uze uqikelele ubungakanani bemveliso.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlela iinketho ngokokuba imveliso incinci okanye inkulu kune-10000 (amawaka ali-10).
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.a: Qikelela ngokungqongqo ukuba yeyiphi imveliso yamanani amabini amakhulu. Le mveliso inamanani amangaphi?
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.c: Fumana ukuba i-500 × 40 isemawakeni okanye emashumini amawaka. Ingaba esi sibini sinokushukumisa isibhengezo sika-Minseo?
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.e: Qikelela ukuba i-120 × 50 isemawakeni okanye emashumini amawaka.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.explain: Ukushukumisa isibhengezo sika-Minseo, ufuna isibini esineemveliso ezinamanani amane. 345 × 27 = 9315, 100 × 10 = 1000, kunye ne-120 × 50 = 6000 zonke zinamanani amane. 999 × 99 = 98901 kunye ne-500 × 40 = 20000 zinamanani amahlanu, ngoko azichasani nesibhengezo sika-Minseo.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.prompt: Vavanya isibhengezo sika-Minseo. Khetha inani elinamanani amathathu a nenani elinamanani amabini b ukwenza isibini esinye esineemveliso enamanani amane nesibini esinye esineemveliso enamanani amahlanu. (Izibini ezimbini kufuneka zibe neemveliso ezinamanani ahlukeneyo.)
z-m-08-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala kumanani amancinci ubale kuqala ukuba imveliso inamanani amangaphi kumanani afana ne-100 ne-10.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.hint.1: Qikelela ukuba kuka-a ne-b kufuneka wenze eyiphi ibe nkulu, kwaye ngokungakanani, ukuze imveliso igqithe kwi-10000.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c2: a kufuneka libe linani elinamanani amathathu ukusuka kwi-100 ukuya kwi-999.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c3: b kufuneka libe linani elinamanani amabini ukusuka kwi-10 ukuya kwi-99.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, 345 × 27 = 9315 linani elinamanani amane kwaye 500 × 40 = 20000 linani elinamanani amahlanu. 100 × 10 = 1000 kunye ne-120 × 50 = 6000 ngamanani anamanani amane, kwaye 999 × 99 = 98901 kunye ne-250 × 60 = 15000 ngamanani anamanani amahlanu. Ibalwa kuphela ukuba iimveliso ezimbini zinamanani ahlukeneyo.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.prompt: Ungathini ngenani lamanani emveliso yenani elinamanani amathathu nelinamanani amabini? Bhala isizathu sakho ngoqikelelo okanye ngokubala ityala elincinci nelona likhulu.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.hint.0: Phindaphinda elona nani linamanani amathathu lincinci ngelona nani linamanani amabini lincinci.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.hint.1: Qikelela imveliso yamanani amabini amakhulu ngokuyithelekisa ne-100 × 100.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ufumene ukuba imveliso encinci kakhulu (100 × 10) neyona inkulu (999 × 99) inamanani amangaphi nganye?
z-m-08-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ucinge ngendlela onokwazi ngayo ukuba yonke imveliso ephakathi inamanani amane okanye amahlanu?
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.0: Linani elinamanani amane okanye elinamanani amahlanu. Elincinci kakhulu, 100 × 10 = 1000, linani elinamanani amane, kwaye elona likhulu, 999 × 99, lingaphantsi kwe-100000 (ikhulu lamawaka), ngoko aliyi kuba linani elinamanani ayisithandathu. Phakathi, liba namanani amahlanu nje ukuba ligqithe kwi-10000.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.1: Imveliso inokuba namanani ama-4 okanye ama-5. 345 × 27 = 9315 inamanani amane, kwaye 500 × 40 = 20000 inamanani amahlanu. Ayinakuba ngaphantsi kwe-1000 kwaye ayinakugqitha kwikhulu lamawaka.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.2: Imveliso linani elinamanani amane okanye amahlanu. Elincinci kakhulu, 100×10=1000, linamanani amane, kwaye elona likhulu, 999×99, lingaphantsi kwekhulu lamawaka, ngoko linamanani amahlanu ubuninzi.

z-m-08-02.title: Amakhadi amabini adibana abe ngama-90: ingaba amanqaku nawo aya kufana?
z-m-08-02.topic: Ukuthelekisa ubukhulu bemveliso yamanani amabini anamanani amabini
z-m-08-02.goal: Qonda ukuba umzekelo omnye awunakuqinisekisa "soloko efana", yenza imizekelo eyahlukileyo ehlangabezana nemeko, uyithelekise, uze uchaze oko imibini enamanqaku amakhulu inako.
z-m-08-02.material: Masidlale umdlalo wamakhadi amanani. Ikhadi ngalinye linenani lemvelo elinye elibhaliweyo elisuka ku-10 ukuya ku-99. Umgaqo: ukhetha amakhadi amabini, kwaye amanani amabini kufuneka adibane abe ngama-90 ngqo. Inqaku lingamanani amabini aphindaphindiweyo. USua wakhetha u-40 no-50 waza wafumana amanqaku angama-2000. Emva koko wathi, "Ukuba isixa singama-90, inqaku lisoloko lingama-2000!" Ulandelelwano olubeka ngalo amakhadi aluhambelani. (30 no-60, kunye no-60 no-30, ngumbini ofanayo.)
z-m-08-02.thinking.0: Ukwahlula oko umzekelo omnye usixelela kona nokungasixeleli
z-m-08-02.prereq.0: Ukuphindaphinda amanani anamanani amabini komnye nomnye (inqanaba lebanga eli-4, ngaphandle kwekhaltyuleyitha)
z-m-08-02.prereq.1: Ukubhanqa amanani emvelo ukuze abe nesixa esifanayo

z-m-08-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isitatimenti sikaSua siqulathe igama elithi "soloko". Cinga ngesenzo esikhawulezayo sokufumanisa ukuba eso sitatimenti sinyanisile na.

z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.a: 40 no-50 banike amanqaku angama-2000, ngoko nawuphi na umbini unika amanqaku angama-2000

z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.b: Akunakugqitywa de sihlole omnye umbini onesixa esingama-90
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.b: Ukhombise ukuba umzekelo omnye wodwa awunakusixelela "soloko".
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.c: Sinokugqiba ngoku nje ukuba amanqaku awafani nokuba izixa ziyafana
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.c: Isiphumo somtshato omnye sodwa asinakuqinisekisa "ayifani". Kufuneka wenze imibini emiye uze uyithelekise.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.d: Asikazi okwangoku. Ngoko akukho mfuneko yokuhlola nawuphi na omnye umbini
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.d: Uchanekile ukuvakalelwa kokuba awazi, kodwa xa ungazi, ukuvavanya linyathelo elilandelayo.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.explain: 40 no-50 benza amanqaku angama-2000 ngumzekelo omnye nje ongaphikisaniyo nesitatimenti sikaSua. Ukwazi ukuba "ukuba isixa singama-90, inqaku lisoloko lifana" linyanisile na, kufuneka uhlole eminye imibini enesixa esingama-90. Ukuba omnye umbini unika inqaku elahlukileyo, loo mbini ngumzekelo ochasayo.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imibini emithathu yamakhadi anamanani amabini anesixa esingama-90 enamanqaku ahlukeneyo. (Ukutshintshisa amakhadi amabini kunika umbini ofanayo.)
z-m-08-02.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha ikhadi lokuqala, emva koko ukhuphe elo nani kwi-90 ukwenza ikhadi lesibini.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tshintsha ikhadi lokuqala, utsibe ukusuka kwi-10 ukuya kwi-90, kodwa uhlole ukuba amanani omabini anamanani amabini.

z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Isixa samanani amabini asingama-90. Wadibanise ukuhlola.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.explain: Imibini enesixa esingama-90 inamanqaku ahlukeneyo, anje nge-(40, 50) = 2000 amanqaku, (30, 60) = 1800 amanqaku, (20, 70) = 1400 amanqaku, (45, 45) = 2025 amanqaku, kunye ne-(11, 79) = 869 amanqaku. z-m-08-06.title: Ukuba udibanisa iiribhoni ezimbini, ziya kwenza i-4 m?
z-m-08-06.topic: Ukudibanisa amanani anamanani amabini edesimali neeyunithi zobude
z-m-08-06.goal: Gweba ukuba unokufikelela esiphelweni ngolwazi olunikiweyo, thetha ukuba sisiphi esinye isinto ekufuneka uyazi, uze uchaze ngamanani ukuba isiphelo sitshintsha njani ngokuxhomekeke kwiimeko.
z-m-08-06.material: Ukubopha kanye ejikeleze ibhokisi yonke, ufuna umtya we-4 m ubuncinane (kanye ngokwaneleyo). Unazo iiribhoni ezimbini: iribhoni ebomvu ye-2.4 m neribhoni eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ye-1.65 m. Ufuna ukudibanisa iiribhoni ezimbini zibe yinye. Awukagqibi ngokuba uzidibanisa 'ngokubeka iziphelo ecaleni komnye uzibambe ngetepu' okanye 'ngokudibanisa iziphelo uzincamathisele'.
z-m-08-06.thinking.2: Ukuveza ngamanani isiphelo esitshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwiimeko
z-m-08-06.prereq.1: Ukwazi ukuba 1 m = 100 cm nokutshintsha iiyunithi zobude

z-m-08-06.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ngeendlela ezimbini zokudibanisa ngokwenene iiribhoni ezimbini, ubhale ubude obupheleleyo kwenye nenye.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, bhala ukuba yeyiphi ingcamango ngendlela iiribhoni ezidityaniswa ngayo efuneka ukuze eso sibhengezo silunge.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.a: Asinakuxela. Kufuneka sazi ukuba yeyiphi iribhoni ejikelezwa kuqala
z-m-08-06.s.s1.r.a: Ulandelelwano lokujikeleza iiribhoni alunempembelelo kubude obupheleleyo. Khangela ulwazi oluchaphazela ubude.
